# ExplorerFocus

> ExplorerFocus is a file explorer for Windows 11 and 10, a replacement for Windows Explorer built for people who always work in the same folders. Each profile is a tab with its own folders, filters and saved state. It adds a preview that opens almost anything, encrypted vaults, remote connections and file tools, and it reads English e-books aloud or turns them into audiobooks. It is made by mBrothers, a brand used by Intrepid Parallel, Lda, in Lisbon, Portugal, and its interface is in 16 languages, including Portuguese from Portugal and from Brazil.

## What it does

- **Profiles:** each tab is a profile with its own tree of folders, so the folders of each piece of work are always one click away.
- **Preview:** code, Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, e-books, images, video and audio, in a side pane or a separate window.
- **Encrypted vaults:** AES-256, in a format compatible with Cryptomator, readable on Android, iOS, macOS and Linux. They open as an ordinary drive letter.
- **Remote connections:** SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, Dropbox and OneDrive, in the same tree as local folders.
- **Tools:** PDF (merge, split and more), images, video and audio, text recognition (OCR), transcription and dictation, and translation, all running on the computer.
- **Read aloud and audiobooks:** English e-books and PDFs read aloud with 28 natural voices, American and British, with the sentence and the word highlighted, each book with its own speed, a sleep timer and marks (free). EPUB to audiobook: an MP3 per chapter with the cover, an M4B with chapters, or an EPUB 3 with the voice inside (PREMIUM; a sample of up to 3 minutes is free). Everything runs on the computer: the voices are downloaded once, with permission, and books are never uploaded.
- **DAISY and audiobook formats:** DAISY 2.02 and DAISY 3 talking books (with text, or audio only) and W3C Audiobooks (.lpf) and Readium audiobooks (.audiobook) are recognised as e-books and play with their own recorded voice, with what is being heard highlighted (free).
- **Compressed archives:** ZIP, RAR, 7z and TAR open like folders. ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ and TAR.BZ2 archives are created from the right-click menu, with no other programs to install, and open in WinZip, WinRAR and 7-Zip; RAR too, with WinRAR installed. A password on ZIP (AES-256) and RAR is PREMIUM.
- **Context menus:** the right-click menus in the tree and the list show the options in columns and, at the top, where the action takes place or how many items are selected.
- **Images:** rotate any image by any angle, degree by degree, with the empty corners cropped or made transparent (free); enhance an image with filters, colour adjustments and a before-and-after comparison (PREMIUM).
- **The browser of your choice:** web pages and internet shortcuts open in the browser you choose, in a normal or private window.
- **My Windows secrets:** where Windows keeps things on the computer: the hidden folders behind %APPDATA%, %LOCALAPPDATA% and the other environment variables, each with its full path and what it is for, and every environment variable with its value (free). What Windows keeps about the user (what was typed in Run, the paths typed in File Explorer, recent files, what was copied, the USB drives it remembers, recently opened programs, the thumbnails of deleted photos, saved notifications, each drive's Recycle Bin and temporary files), with the way to get there by hand; some of it can be deleted, temporary files and the Recycle Bin only when older than 7 days (PREMIUM).
- **Docs:** Word (.doc, .docx), text (.txt), Markdown (.md), RTF and LibreOffice (.odt) documents, with their own button: listen to them read aloud with natural English voices, the sentence lit up as it's read (free); make an audio version (an MP3 per part, an M4B with the parts or an EPUB with the voice inside, to listen to on the phone or in the car; a sample is free), translate the whole document into a new Word file or .txt with the headings kept, or turn its pages into PNG or JPEG images (PREMIUM). It all happens on the computer.
- **Operations that say what is happening:** copies and moves show progress and explain why when something cannot be done.

## The essentials

- **Windows 11, or Windows 10 version 1809 or later, 64-bit.**
- **One signed .exe, with no installer and nothing else to install** (self-contained, .NET 10 and WPF). A .zip is also available for organisations that block .exe downloads.
- **Free version with no time limit, no account and no ads.** PREMIUM adds more; the current price is on the website.
- **Privacy:** the app works on the computer; the only things it sends are listed on the privacy page, and the anonymous usage counts can be turned off.
- **Languages:** English (UK and US), Portuguese (Portugal), Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, French, Italian, German, Polish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese and Korean.
- **Uninstalling:** About (the "i" button at the top right) → "Remove ExplorerFocus from this computer…".
